name: io.github.meococ/765t-forge
title: 765T Forge
description: AutoCAD 2025/2026 MCP server for metro/AEC drawing production workflows

environmentVariables.name: FORGE_AUTOCAD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret the AutoCAD plugin validates on every pipe call. Set a long random value; the AutoCAD process must inherit the same value.

environmentVariables.name: FORGE_PIPE_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Named pipe the plugin listens on (default 765T.Forge.AutoCAD).

environmentVariables.name: FORGE_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma list of toolsets to enable at startup, or 'all' for the full 120+ tool catalog. Default: core + discovery tools.

environmentVariables.name: FORGE_BACKUP_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for byte-verified drawing backups before mutating operations.

environmentVariables.name: FORGE_AUDIT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the append-only audit log of mutating tool calls.
